policy: Prospective underlying-stock price returns, not executed trades or rating win rates. Entry is the first observed session strictly after the version recording date; Calendar horizons start at that entry and roll to the next regular NYSE session. Missing expected sessions never shift entry/exit later. Emergency closures are not inferred; withhold scoring until a reviewed calendar correction. Benchmarks use the identical entry/exit sessions. Cohort is frozen at publication, equal-weight buy-and-hold excluding the subject, and requires every member (no survivor substitution). Only USD split-adjusted closes are comparable; dividends, costs, slippage and FX are excluded. Sell/Hold calls are not silently converted into short trades. Missing prices stay pending.
